The '''''Machine Tool Storage Unit Alpha-Four''''' was an orbital storage warehouse used during the construction of the first [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]]. It was also used briefly as a refuge by [[Celot Ratua Dil]] while effecting his escape from [[Despayre]]. It contained mostly replacement parts for assorted mechanical devices being used for construction of the Death Star. It also contained large gas tanks of oxygen and hydrogen, a locker with several [[Environment suit/Legends|Vac suits]], and a general service [[Droid/Legends|droid]] in another crate. Most fortunately, a crate of [[Vulderanian grain flakes]] had also been mislaid on board the storage unit. Ratua made use of all of these items to in turn to finally smuggle himself on to the Death Star.
